title: POST /api/projects/:id/points — manual points adjustment with reason
description: Allow users to manually add or subtract points from their project with a required reason note.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
delta must be between -500 and +500 (prevent abuse)

steps.details: On projects router, add POST '/:id/points': 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Validate: delta = z.number().int().min(-500).max(500), reason = z.string().min(1).max(255). 3) Call awardPoints(projectId, delta, reason, 'manual'). 4) Fetch updated project. 5) Return 200 { pointsTotal: project.pointsTotal, level: project.level }.
POST +100 points — verify total increases. POST -200 — verify deduction (floors at 0). POST without reason — expect 400.
